## VaultETH — What's Next

### 🔴 Blockers (must-do before real funds)

These are the [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/SECURITY.md) release gates — none are skippable:

1. **CI must pass** — The GitHub Actions workflow builds and runs tests. It needs a Mac runner with Xcode + `xcodegen`. Check the [swift.yml](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/.github/workflows/swift.yml) workflow to confirm it's using a recent enough Xcode (needs 15+ for iOS 17 deployment target). The unit tests for signing, address derivation, and wei math should pass on first run since they use independently verified vectors.

2. **Physical device testing** — Simulator can't test Face ID or real Keychain. Needs:
   - Create → back up → delete → reinstall → import (verify same address)
   - Face ID and passcode-only device paths
   - A test mainnet send from a throwaway wallet

3. **Independent security review** — Especially the signing path ([`WalletEngine.sign`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletEngine.swift#L95-L112)) and Keychain access control setup ([`KeychainVault`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/KeychainVault.swift))

Why can’t they be saved??

Depending on whether you are referring to **recovery seed words**, **code changes**, or **App Store checklist items**, here is why:

---

### 1. 🔑 If you mean the Recovery Phrase (12 Words)
In VaultETH and crypto wallets generally, **recovery phrases cannot and should not be saved digitally** (in iCloud, Notes, photo albums, or cloud servers) for critical security reasons:

* **Complete Wallet Ownership:** Anyone who obtains those 12 words has permanent, unrestricted access to all funds in the wallet across any device or wallet software.
* **Cloud & Screenshot Vulnerabilities:** Cloud backups (iCloud/Google Drive), photo libraries, clipboards, and note apps are frequently targeted by malware, SIM-swap attacks, and data breaches. If saved digitally, funds can be drained silently.
* **Device-Only Keychain Enclosure:** In [`KeychainVault.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/KeychainVault.swift#L31-L52), VaultETH explicitly marks the recovery phrase with `kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly`. It never syncs to iCloud backups and is guarded behind Face ID / Touch ID / device passcode.
* **App-Switcher Privacy:** In [`WalletsView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletsView.swift#L189-L192), the recovery phrase is wiped from memory as soon as you switch away from the app so iOS cannot save a screenshot preview of it in the multitasking switcher.
* **Paper / Metal Backup:** This is why users must write the words down on physical paper or stamped metal and store them offline.

---

### 2. 💻 If you mean Repository Code & Files
If you are asking whether your project code, files, or commits are being saved:
* **They are saved!** Every change made is automatically committed and pushed directly to your GitHub repository ([ganiyucall911/VaultETH](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH)).
* The latest commits containing the [`APP_STORE_CHECKLIST.md`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/APP_STORE_CHECKLIST.md), app icons, [`PRIVACY_POLICY.md`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/PRIVACY_POLICY.md), and [`SUPPORT.md`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/SUPPORT.md) are already saved and pushed to `main`.

---

### 3. 📋 If you mean App Store Submission Checklist Items
In [`APP_STORE_CHECKLIST.md`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/APP_STORE_CHECKLIST.md):
* **Code & Asset items (Section 1)**: These *are* fully implemented and saved in the repository (privacy manifest, camera/biometric descriptions, app icons, legal documents).
* **Apple Developer & App Store Connect items (Section 2)**: These cannot be automated or saved directly in Git because they require signing into your personal/organization Apple Developer portal with your Apple ID credentials to upload builds, configure banking/tax information, and submit for review.

### 1. 💎 Concept of Identity: *The Sovereign Obsidian Vault*

Most crypto wallets fall into one of two extremes:
* **The Cartoon/Toy archetype** (*MetaMask, Rainbow*): Crude 8-bit blockies, emoji-laden interfaces, or playful candy gradients that feel non-serious for personal wealth security.
* **The Web2 Bank replica** (*Coinbase, Trust Wallet*): Sterile gray-and-blue lists that look indistinguishable from conventional fintech apps.

#### What makes VaultETH different and superior:
* **Architectural Metaphor — The Obsidian Vault:** An impervious, luxury safe-deposit vault crafted from deep obsidian glass (`#0A0D14`), precision titanium bezel borders, and iridescent crystalline Ethereum refraction.
* **Algorithmic Cryptographic Crests ([`VaultIdenticon.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/VaultIdenticon.swift)):**
  * Rather than generic circular avatars or retro pixel squares, every Ethereum address is deterministically mapped to a unique **Geometric Crest**.
  * Renders a multi-faceted Ethereum diamond core, concentric titanium bitfield orbit rings, and a signature prismatic gradient aura mathematically computed from the address's hex bytes.
  * No two vaults or recipients look alike, giving each account an unmistakable, sovereign digital signet that illuminates when active.

---

### 2. 📱 UI & UX System Overhaul

#### A. Modern 4-Tab Navigation & Command Cockpit ([`RootView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/RootView.swift))
* **Streamlined Architecture:** Reorganized from 6 crowded tabs into an intuitive 4-tab powerhouse: **Vault** (Home), **Wallets**, **Activity**, and **Settings**.
* **Quick-Action Cockpit:** Direct access to **Send**, **Receive**, **Scan**, and **Copy** directly on the hero Vault card without tab jumping.
* **Discreet Balance Mode:** Added an instant privacy toggle (`eye` / `eye.slash`) in the navigation bar to mask balances (`•••••••• ETH`) with smooth spring animations when in public or recording screen captures.
* **Live Network Beacon:** Real-time pulse indicator showing Ethereum Mainnet connectivity and synchronization status.

#### B. The Digital Vault Pass ([`RootView.swift: ReceiveView`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/RootView.swift#L327-L407))
* Styled like an executive cryptographic VIP credential card:
  * Centered large `VaultIdenticon` with ambient back-glow.
  * High-contrast QR frame with rounded corners.
  * One-tap copy with floating animated confirmation toast.
  * Native iOS `ShareLink` for instant address sharing.

#### C. Frictionless Transfer Experience ([`SendView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/SendView.swift))
* **Interactive Amount Presets:** Quick-select chips (`25%`, `50%`, `75%`, `Max`) that automatically calculate available balances with gas fee headroom.
* **Recipient Identity Preview:** Typing an address or ENS name immediately generates their verified `VaultIdenticon` and checksum confirmation before proceeding.
* **Cryptographic Review Receipt:** Shows visual transfer direction (*Your Crest ➔ Recipient Crest*), exact fee breakdowns, and biometric gating (*"Authorize with Biometrics"*).

#### D. Multi-Vault Management ([`WalletsView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletsView.swift))
* Replaced plain list rows with **Tactile Glass Vault Cards** showcasing active status tags, backup verification shields, and derived addresses.
* **Numbered Word Capsules:** Redesigned [`RecoveryPhraseView`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletsView.swift#L248-L352) with an elegant 2-column numbered grid (words 1 through 12) inside frosted glass capsules, preserving automatic memory clearing on app-switching.

#### E. Filterable Activity Hub ([`TransactionHistoryView.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/TransactionHistoryView.swift))
* Added segmented status filtering (**All**, **Confirmed**, **Pending**).
* Each row features the recipient's unique identicon, on-chain status beacons, and tap-to-inspect modal sheets with direct Etherscan deep links.

#### F. Design System Tokens ([`LiquidGlass.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/LiquidGlass.swift))
* Standardized semantic design tokens: `Color.vaultBackground`, `Color.vaultCardSurface`, `Color.vaultCyan`, `Color.vaultViolet`, `Color.vaultEmerald`, and `Color.vaultAmber`.
* Added `.vaultCard()` with specular highlights, `.vaultGlass()` with titanium borders, and `.vaultButton()` with spring haptic feedback.

#### 2. ⚡ Dynamic Multi-Chain JSON-RPC Client ([`EthereumRPC.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/EthereumRPC.swift))
* Dynamically adapts to whichever network is currently selected.
* **Dual Gas Model:** Supports modern EIP-1559 base fee calculation with priority tips on networks like Ethereum, Base, and Arbitrum, while automatically falling back to standard `eth_gasPrice` on legacy or alternate EVM nodes (e.g. BNB Smart Chain).
* Preserves multi-endpoint failover across all chains.

---

#### 3. 🔑 Cross-Chain Address Derivation ([`WalletEngine.swift`](https://github.com/ganiyucall911/VaultETH/blob/main/WalletEngine.swift#L113-L147))

  1. **EVM Chains:** Universal `0x…` address (shared across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Linea, etc.).
  2. **Solana:** Native Base58 Solana address (`wallet.getAddressForCoin(coin: .solana)`).
  3. **Bitcoin:** Native SegWit Bech32 (`bc1q…`) address (`wallet.getAddressForCoin(coin: .bitcoin)`).
